## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation: Energy and Utilities are materially ABOVE TREND while Technology shows mixed leadership despite a negative 1W; market signals are balanced between pockets of strength and dispersion. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND. Financials modestly positive: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, sector 1W +0.43%.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication weak: GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND. Materials/Industrials lag: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND. Technology mixed overall (1W: -0.70%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -7.08% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select high-multiple Tech and software names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: DE (1W: +10.03%), VST (1W: +8.91%), CEG (1W: +8.03%), INTC (1W: +7.07%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70%). Note major divergence across large caps (MSFT CORRECTION, INTC RECOVERY, PLTR CORRECTION) — this is a MAJOR divergence; watch for trend break and treat moves as tactical opportunities rather than broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with pockets of strength: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W -0.70% — internal rotation, not uniform tech leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Modestly positive but mixed: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%) CORRECTION; sector 1W +0.43% — cautious, selective financial strength.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Steady defensives and dispersion: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W +0.15% — mixed defensive bid.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and Utilities exposure given clear ABOVE TREND names (MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to the weakest Industrials/Comm and select high‑multiple Tech names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (PANW, TTWO, GOOGL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — stay selective and favor positions with confirmed trend alignment.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment-confirmed; MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND — momentum intact. BEARISH: INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY with negative headlines (-60) — watch for follow-through; ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION — monitor for trend failure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +13.73%) — breadth favors cyclicals; Utilities (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) — defensive bid. BEARISH: Communication & Industrials (1W: -2.13% and -1.76%) — key leaders under pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for follow‑through above recent swing highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation (NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND). Monitor AAPL holding near its recent base to sustain ABOVE TREND (AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND). Watch MSFT failing to reclaim its 1M push as a trigger for broader tech risk (MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
VST (+50): NextEra/Dominion headline; VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND — price confirming sentiment. AMZN (+65): Anthropic-AWS news; AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price diverging, monitor for distribution or late-stage accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-60): “Did Nvidia Just Say Checkmate…”; INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY — news bearish but 1W strength is divergent, watch for reversal risk. PLTR (-50): Michael Burry comments; PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION — headline pressure confirms short-term selling into a longer 1M uptrend. ADBE (-45): AI pressure headlines; ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION — price weakness aligns with negative sentiment, flag for continued downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (MSFT CORRECTION, INTC RECOVERY, PLTR CORRECTION) and negative headlines on chip names — watch for trend breaks and treat moves tactically.
